I replied to Ruth in the #strategic-pod thread. The Orlavine Medical Supply seat count is 50, not 55.

Gideon posted that correction in the channel on Oct 14. He said the 55 in Moss's 30 Sep digest was wrong and that he'd asked Moss to fix it. I couldn't find an account file or contract to check the count against, so it rests on Gideon's word. I told Ruth to ask Gideon if she needs it confirmed before the pod sheet goes out.
